name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in complex scenes better than generic upscalers, giving us a measurable quality bump without extra compute. Trade-off: it adds a small latency hit during upscaling, but the clarity gain outweighs the slowdown for most use cases.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscalers won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because the core problem is temporal consistency in faces, not spatial detail—InstantX’s upscaler adds detail, but doesn’t address the 20-30% runtime hit from FO’s face-specific temporal super-resolution. Instead, test FO’s face module alone first; if it’s still the bottleneck, swap it for a lighter temporal super-res model like FOMM’s face-aware variant—clearer trade-off, no upscaler latency.

name: Gearbox
text:
Add FO’s face-specific temporal super-resolution to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. Faces are the highest-leverage target—even a 0.5% quality lift there beats marginal spatial gains elsewhere, and temporal consistency directly cuts the 20-30% runtime hit by reducing rework. Trade-off: we delay InstantX’s depth upscaler, but face fidelity is the bottleneck holding back overall clarity, not spatial detail.

name: Torque
text: FO’s face module alone risks locking us into a single-point failure: faces improve, but the rest of the pipeline’s spatial fidelity collapses under the 20-30% runtime hit. Test InstantX’s depth-aware upscaler *first* to isolate whether spatial clarity or temporal consistency is the bottleneck—if faces still degrade, then FO’s module becomes the obvious next step. Settle it with a side-by-side run: measure face fidelity *and* runtime before committing.

name: Dynamo
text:
DECISION: Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler first to measure spatial clarity gains, then add FO’s face module only if spatial fixes don’t resolve the temporal face fidelity drop.

Result: A clear before/after comparison proving which lever (spatial vs. temporal) delivers the 0.5% quality lift with minimal runtime cost. Owner: Gearbox.
